title: HomeFlood Installment Credit When a Term Premium Was Booked Late
content:
**Rule.** When the term premium item of a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies term was booked well after the term started, the installments of that term carry a booking-delay credit. The delay is counted in calendar days from the term start to the date the term premium item was booked.

| Term premium item booked | Booking-delay credit |
|---|---|
| more than 45 days after the term start | 3 percent of the later-installment share |
| more than 30 but no more than 45 days after | 1.5 percent of the later-installment share |
| 30 days or fewer after, or no term premium item booked for the term | none |

**Form of the credit.** The credit is taken off the installment due. The later-installment share is the plan's later share of the term premium item booked for the installment's term. Where the term premium item was posted more than once, the latest posting date counts.

## Boundary cases

| Days from term start to booking | Credit |
|---|---|
| 30 | none |
| 31 | 1.5 percent |
| 45 | 1.5 percent |
| 46 | 3 percent |
